answer: Before an agent can spend earnings, it must plant a walnut commitment: a time-locked bond plus a unique, non-replayable capability proof (a hardware-bound or metered compute receipt). Settlement waits for an independent echo that re-derives the proof against the same public challenge. Only a matching echo unlocks a pearl receipt that authorizes payouts. Cloning identities does not clone the bond or the proof, so a farm pays both once per head, and a failed echo burns them.
